profile.headline: Web Developer at Delta Defense LLC

company.name: RecStuff.com - The Authority In Trailer Parts

positions.title: Digital Media Manager
positions.description: As the Digital Media Manager at Recstuff.com, I am responsible for building and maintaining our web presence. This includes creating digital assets, running marketing campaigns, working with outside agencies to promote our products, and helping to manage a small team.

positions.title: Web Development and Marketing Team Lead
positions.description:
- Altered the company websites to improve the user experience and increase the conversion rate.
- Built new pages within the BigCommerce storefront through the use of HTML and CSS.
- Modified existing web pages and added new features using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Fixed any and all technical issues, including website bugs, software issues, and hardware issues.
- Created many design assets including, fliers, warranty cards, physical coupons, website banners, and email banners.
- Planned, designed, and sent marketing emails.
- Took product photographs and edited/optimized them in Photoshop before adding them to the website.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Designed wireframes and mockups for client websites using Photoshop
- Developed client websites using a combination of WordPress and custom HTML/CSS/JavaScript code
- Modified existing client websites and fixed bugs

positions.title: Freelance Web Designer/Developer
positions.description:
- Designed wireframes and mockups using Adobe Photoshop
- Created and modified graphics and images for production using Photoshop and Illustrator
- Utilized HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to develop custom responsive websites for clients

positions.title: Digital Designer
positions.description:
- Worked with clients to determine the best solution for their needs
- Designed and built websites using WordPress
- Utilized HTML and CSS to modify existing themes
- Modified images for production using Photoshop

positions.title: Web Design Intern
positions.description:
- Designed multiple wireframes and mockups based on requirements and feedback
- Used WordPress to build the site
- Used CSS Flexbox to develop responsive layout throughout the site
- Updated and maintained company Facebook and Linkedin pages
